title: 01 / Which capacity rescues the deadline?
text: Q Factoria solves the official baselines with Q A O A simulation at four and eight hours. Our extension asks which capacity rescues a manufacturing deadline. Two pumps are due at minute nine hundred, with one furnace unavailable. Each pump retains sixteen operations. The complete native reference proves forty five weighted late minutes are unavoidable.

title: 02 / Replacement capacity makes both orders on time
text: Replacement heat capacity becomes usable at minute three hundred and sixty. The complete model certifies an on time optimum. These are independently checked saved plans. Machines, qualified workers, calendars, attendance, family setups and minimum transfer times constrain the decision. Vehicle and quality simulation remain separate.

title: 03 / A smaller pool hides that benefit
text: Select the smaller candidate pool on the same replacement scenario. Forty five late minutes return. Even solving this pool exactly misses the schedule it excluded. Every operation remains, but assignment choices were lost. This separates representation loss from solver failure; other compact encodings may do better.

title: 04 / Model the recipe, people and conflicts
text: A bit chooses an operation, machine, worker and start time. One hot groups require one assignment. Pair penalties forbid resource conflicts and broken precedence. The objective prioritizes weighted tardiness, then makespan. Safe support pruning preserves the declared grid domain. A capped pool is a lossy restriction.

title: 05 / Measure the cost of retaining recovery choices
text: The complete replacement QUBO uses two thousand four hundred and ninety nine bits. This pool uses seven hundred and eighty one. We retain both encodings, input identities, checked plans and certified native references. Compiling the complete QUBO does not mean a quantum backend solved it.

title: 06 / Separate quantum validation from factory scale
text: The separate quantum microscope implements W preparation and X Y mixing across all one hot groups. All sixty test schedules match certified optima; fifty seven measured states are exact QUBO minima. Annealing reaches all sixty too. Sector simulation enumerates energies classically. This is bounded correctness evidence, not quantum advantage or a thirty two operation quantum result.

title: 07 / Scaling, negative controls and the backend question
text: The study reaches one hundred and twenty eight operations; larger complete references remain unresolved. Our CPU annealing pilot fails to improve its heuristics. A smaller safe penalty reduces feasibility at these settings. Six larger models have exact integer SDK packets with disclosed heuristic initialization. No Velox Q credits were used; performance remains unmeasured.

title: 08 / A decision with an auditable explanation
text: Our contribution is a concrete capacity decision and a measured cost of discarding recovery choices. Negative results, source snapshots and independent checks remain available. This local review draft uses actual interface captures and synthetic narration. All factory parameters are synthetic.
